Mahadev App Case: ED Questions Host, BJP Expels Member

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) is investigating the Mahadev betting app case, with inquiries extending to digital promotion channels and involving individuals like TV host Shefali Bagga. The probe has reportedly expanded internationally, with searches in Dubai, Mauritius, and the UK. In a related development, the BJP has expelled Vikas Garg following his arrest in connection with the case.
